speaker: Old Kings' Cairn
description: An Old Kings' cairn at the Barrow Fields (plan M6-M9 §5.4, decision 33): reading it once gives one attribute point (once-flag reward.cairn.barrow_fields).

nodes.text: Stones stacked by giant hands among the barrows. The topmost bears a crowned mark and a line cut deep: 'Here we laid the ones who grew too great to bury.'

choices.text: [Lay a hand on the stones] (+1 attribute point)

nodes.text: An Old Kings' cairn. Its strength is already in you.
